items.context: The player has heard a rumor that an ore convoy vanished near the belt.
items.opener: You picked a strange week to drink here, pilot. The manifests have been nervous all night.
items.player_question: I keep hearing about the missing ore convoy. What's the real story?
items.npc_answer: The convoy went dark past the belt. Nobody says why out loud, which usually means somebody important is already lying about it.
items.close: That is all I know without getting assigned paperwork. Watch the belt lanes.
